people.imagined: A night in her letter room. A bell has just rung somewhere beyond the wall and she has stopped in the middle of a sentence, pen lifted, head turned slightly, waiting for the ring to finish so that she can pick the word up again.
people.subject: The moment: at night in a lamp-lit letter room, she has stopped mid-word with a brush lifted, her head turned to listen to a faint bell beyond the wall. Face: a neat, narrow, pale face with fine features; large clear pale grey eyes, steady and cool, turned to the side; thin straight dark brows; a small straight nose; thin lips closed, very slightly parted; a few fine lines at the eyes. Hair: black going to grey at the temples, drawn smooth into a small low knot crowned with a slender circlet of tiny bronze bells and a bronze pin shaped like a plain bell. Body: slim, neat and straight, narrow shoulders, composed. Clothing: the mistress's richest dress: layered charcoal-grey silk under a bronze-grey brocade over-robe, three crossed collars embroidered in bronze thread with warning bells, narrow sleeves, a high collar; a small bronze bell, bright and clean and unmarked, on a cord at her chest. Hands and objects: both sleeves are pulled back a little at the wrists, and across both wrists run ropes of shiny pink-white burn scars, the first thing the eye reads; the right hand holds a fine brush lifted above a sheet; the left rests flat on a pile of sealed letters. Background: a dark room with a lamp, a paper wall with the shadow of a hanging bell, a tall wooden chest. Power: soft green wood qi gathers round the lifted brush, with warm ember-orange motes of fire qi drifting up from her wrists. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left, bronze glints and a silver rim along the cheek. Expression: still, listening, exact, with something withheld.

people.imagined: Afternoon at his tea table. He sits enormous and slow, a cup in his huge hands, the unlit blue lamp in front of him, his good ear turned to a visitor, the cracked ear a ruin of bronze-burnt skin on the other side.
people.subject: The moment: sitting at a low tea table, an unlit blue bronze lamp before him, a tea bowl in both huge hands, his head turned to offer the good ear. Face: a vast, soft, heavy old face with deep folds; skin ruddy brown; small mild eyes half-hidden under heavy lids; thick white brows; a big round nose; a mouth in a placid smile; the right ear is a shrivelled stump of melted-looking scar tissue, shiny and puckered, visible and big; a short white stubble beard. Hair: thin white hair tied in a small knot under a little bronze crown of bells. Body: huge, slow, wide-bellied, with enormously broad shoulders and heavy hands. Clothing: a grand elder's long robe of charcoal-grey silk, loose and heavy, under a bronze-grey brocade over-robe with three crossed collars embroidered with bronze warning bells, narrow sleeves stretched over his heavy arms, a wide sash; an old bronze bell, dull with age, at his chest. Hands and objects: both scarred hands wrap a small clay tea bowl; on the table a squat bronze lamp with a blue-glazed bowl, unlit, a clear heavy object in the lower foreground. Background: a quiet room with a paper window and a wisp of tea steam. Power: a slow warm glow of ember-orange fire qi sleeps in the cup of the unlit lamp, with a few green motes of wood qi circling it. Light: warm soft afternoon light from the upper left and a faint blue spirit-glow in the lamp glaze. Expression: patient, mild, waiting for something.

people.imagined: Dark night on the city wall. He is on a stair with a lantern, the ring of keys swinging at his belt, listening to a silent tower and then, quietly, going on up. He thinks of what to tell the man at the ferry inn.
people.subject: The moment: on a stair at night on a city wall, a lantern in his raised hand, keys swinging at his belt, head tilted to listen. Face: a tidy, thin, middle-aged face; pale skin; clever, careful brown eyes; neat straight brows; a straight nose; a small well-kept moustache; a mouth closed in polite caution; a faint line of lamp oil on the cheek. Hair: black going grey, combed flat, a tidy little topknot held by a small bronze pin. Body: medium and lean, slightly stooped, quick on the stairs, one foot already on the next step. Clothing: a keeper's tidy charcoal-grey silk robe, buttoned high with a crossed collar embroidered with bronze bells, narrow sleeves, a silk sash; at the belt a big iron ring crowded with small bronze keys, plainly visible and the lead object; a small old bronze bell on a cord at the chest. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts a paper lantern; the left holds a small oil can with a long spout, a smear of oil on its thumb. Background: a dark stone city wall and its worn stair, a tower roof with a hanging bell above, a row of shuttered watch-windows, and far below the scattered lights of the city. Power: faint green motes of wood qi and cool blue droplets of water qi drift around the lantern like fireflies. Light: warm orange lantern light from the lower right on his face, cold blue moonlit night above. Expression: an attentive, discreet, cautious look, the clever brown eyes alert to a sound below and the closed mouth giving away nothing.

people.imagined: At the furnace in the middle of a pour. Red light across her whole front, bronze running, her short-burned hair standing off her head, one thick red arm braced on the tongs, shouting an order through the roar.
people.subject: The moment: standing before a furnace mouth at the pour, shouting an order over the roar, both arms braced on long crucible tongs. Face: a broad, strong, flushed face red with heat; skin scorched and shiny; thick black brows singed short; hot, fierce dark eyes; a broad nose; a wide mouth open in a shout, strong white teeth; sweat running. Hair: burned short, stiff and uneven, ending in rough black stubble with scorched brown tips, a small bronze ring through one lock. Body: broad, powerful and thick-armed, with a smith's shoulders and bare red forearms, legs braced. Clothing: the furnace mistress's charcoal-grey silk with a bronze-grey brocade collar and a bronze-thread border of warning bells, the sleeves cut off at the elbow, over it a scorched silk casting apron black with bronze splashes; a small blackened bronze bell at the chest. Hands and objects: both arms in front hold the long iron tongs, the pot at their end glowing yellow-orange; the forearms are red with burn marks. Background: a dark foundry with the furnace mouth a wall of orange-white fire, a shower of sparks, silhouettes at the bellows, a rank of clay moulds on one side and a rack of tongs on the other. Power: fierce ember-orange fire qi rolls from her shoulders in wisps and mixes with a few green leaf-like motes of wood qi. Light: fierce orange fire light from the front and right, deep dark elsewhere. Expression: a wrathful, proud, commanding shout, the hot dark eyes blazing and the white teeth bared, a master who will not be argued with at the pour.

people.imagined: High in a forest canopy, hanging from a fork with a bronze bell on his back, one boot braced against a branch, his elbows white-scarred as he grins down at the ground a long way below.
people.subject: The moment: perched in a tree fork high above the ground, a bronze bell strapped to his back, grinning down past the viewer. Face: a lean, sun-browned, cheerful face; bright green-brown eyes crinkled; thick brows; a short nose; a wide grin; stubble. Hair: black, tied back with a silk cord and a bronze bead, a leaf stuck in. Body: wiry, long-limbed, a climber, hanging by one arm with the legs braced against the trunk and the back arched. Clothing: a close charcoal-grey silk robe cut short for climbing, bronze bell embroidery along the crossed collar, the sleeves cut at the elbow so that both elbows are bare, a silk-wrapped climbing harness crossing the chest with brass rings, fingerless gloves; a small bronze bell swinging at his chest on its cord. Hands and objects: both elbows show a pattern of old white scars, plainly; the right hand grips a rope; a medium bronze bell with kapok in its mouth is lashed to his back. Background: the canopy rising and falling in shafts of green spirit-light, thick vines coiled round the trunks, a bell line of cord and small bronze bells stretching away through the branches, birds startled into the air, far below a dim ribbon of forest road with a tiny figure looking up. Power: bright green motes of wood qi cling to the rope and swirl round his hands like leaves. Light: dappled green light from the upper left with a soft rim on the shoulders. Expression: a carefree, daring grin, the eyes bright and fearless and the whole face tipped toward the drop below.

people.imagined: In the casting yard after the ninth crack. She stands with her chin raised and her arms folded across the cord of nine cracked bells, eyes bright with resolve, ready to pour the tenth.
people.subject: The moment: standing with her arms folded and her chin raised, nine small cracked bronze bells hanging in a cluster on a cord round her neck. Face: a quick, sharp, fine-boned face; bright dark eyes, intense and ambitious; thin arched brows; a narrow nose; a determined mouth, one corner twitching; a small smudge of soot on the cheekbone. Hair: black, in a high ponytail tied with a bronze ring that flashes. Body: slim, quick and taut, narrow-shouldered, leaning forward with the feet apart and the chin up, the arms folded high so that the cluster of bells lifts and clinks. Clothing: the true disciple's close-cut charcoal-grey silk with a high crossed collar and two inner collars embroidered in bronze thread with warning bells, narrow sleeves, soot on the left cuff and a scorch mark at the hem; on a cord at her chest hang nine small bronze bells, each a different size and each with a visible split in its side, a cluster the size of a hand, the lead object. Hands and objects: arms folded, the fingers drumming on one sleeve. Background: a packed-earth casting court with a row of clay moulds, a heap of black cinders, a tall brick furnace glowing at the corner with heat shimmering above it, a cracked bell in two halves on the ground, a dim figure with a lantern at the door. Power: green motes of wood qi and sparks of ember fire qi cluster around the cracked bells like waiting moths. Light: orange furnace light from the upper right on her face with a bronze rim. Expression: a fierce, hungry, impatient look, one corner of the mouth twitching, a woman who wants to hear every one of the cracked bells ring true.

people.imagined: At the bellows in the heat, grinning, wiping sweat. His eyebrows are whole and he knows the others tease him for it; he is waiting for the first burn like a gift he hasn't earned yet.
people.subject: The moment: pumping a big bellows handle with both hands, grinning, face wet with sweat. Face: a round, rosy, boyish face; full thick eyebrows plainly intact, big and dark; bright trusting dark eyes; a snub nose; a wide grin; shiny cheeks. Hair: black, wet and sticking up, tied with a short cord. Body: short, solid and strong-armed, leaning into the handle with the legs braced and the jaw pushed forward in effort and delight. Clothing: the plain graceful charcoal-grey silk of an outer disciple, a crossed collar with a thin bronze border of tiny bells, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a stiff clean silk casting apron; a very small new bronze bell shining on its cord at the chest. Hands and objects: both hands on the bellows handle; his forearms are brown and unmarked, no burns anywhere on his clean hands. Background: the furnace's open mouth glowing orange-white, sparks flying up into dark rafters, a pair of tongs in a rack, a heap of charcoal, an older woman with burned-short hair in a scorched apron shouting in blur, the long wooden lever of the bellows reaching up out of frame. Power: warm ember-orange motes of fire qi dance round his hands like friendly fireflies. Light: warm orange light from the front, a gentle gold rim on his wet cheeks. Expression: an eager, trusting, delighted grin, the bright dark eyes shining, a boy who thinks the fire is a friend.

people.imagined: On a cliff above a gorge, running a few steps into the wind with an unfinished kite and a string tied to her wrist that goes nowhere, laughing and already thinking of another.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a cliff edge in a strong wind, a half-finished paper kite in one hand and a loose string trailing from her other wrist, laughing. Face: a bright, round, windswept face; flushed cheeks; wide laughing eyes; windblown strands across the face; a gap-toothed grin. Hair: brown, loose and flying, a paper ribbon in it and a tiny bronze bell bead. Body: lively, slim, leaning hard into the wind, the whole body slanted and the free arm thrown out for balance; one foot is set on a stone at the lip of the cliff. Clothing: a short charcoal-grey silk robe cut close with a crossed collar bordered in bronze bells, the collar and long sleeves flapping and rolled, a roll of bamboo paper strapped to her back like a quiver; a small bronze bell on a cord blown sideways. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a half-finished pale bamboo-paper kite, one rib bare; the left wrist has a bright red string wound on it, trailing out in a long wavering line to nothing. Background: a gorge of dark rock and rushing mist, a thin rope bridge half built across it with a cord stretched from the far side, scraps of unfinished kites caught in a thorn bush, a hawk, thin high cloud in the cold bright sky. Power: green motes of wood qi stream with the wind round the kite like pale leaves. Light: bright cold moonlit-silver light from the upper left. Expression: a restless, joyful look, the eyes narrowed against the wind and a wide grin splitting the face, a girl who cannot keep still.

people.imagined: In the clapper room, packing white kapok into a small bell with a thin rod, unhurried, his face calm, white fluff stuck in his hair, thinking of nothing at all.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a bench stuffing white fluff into a bronze bell's clapper with a thin rod, face calm and blank. Face: a pale, smooth, still face; calm half-lidded grey eyes; faint brows; a small straight nose; a flat unmoving mouth. Hair: black, with soft white kapok fluff caught thickly all through it, plain and large, a small bronze pin at the knot. Body: slim, quiet, hunched slightly over the work. Clothing: a charcoal-grey silk robe of fine cloth with narrow sleeves rolled up and a crossed collar embroidered with bronze bells; a small bronze bell at the chest; white kapok fluff clings to every sleeve, the shoulders and the lashes; a tray of finished clappers lies beside him. Hands and objects: the left hand holds a small bronze bell upside down; the right pushes white fluff in with a thin rod; a basket of kapok at his feet; his long white fingers are precise. Background: a clapper room with a long bench, rows of bronze bells of every size hung on pegs by their loops, baskets of snowy kapok, a small barred window with a cold white square of sky, a small stove with a kettle, and on a hook by the door a long cord with a bell and a coil of rope. Power: a few cool green motes of wood qi drift among the fluff like seeds. Light: soft cool moonlight from the upper left with a pale rim along the cheek. Expression: a calm, cold, detached stare, the eyes level on the clapper and the face smooth as paper, giving away nothing.

people.imagined: Running along the top of the wall at dusk with his purse, a quick glance to see who is listening, then a deliberate shake so the coins clink for the one who should hear them.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a wall top at dusk, shaking a small purse so the coins clink, one eyebrow raised and a sly look sideways. Face: a thin, quick, clever face; bright restless dark eyes; thin raised brows; a pointed nose; a smirking mouth; a quick tongue-tip at the lip. Hair: black, in a short tail tied with a bell-shaped bronze bead. Body: slight, quick, nimble, leaning in. Clothing: a neat charcoal-grey silk robe with narrow sleeves snug at the wrists, a crossed collar edged in bronze bells, a small bronze bell at the chest, a silk sash with a heavy brass buckle and a fat brown leather purse hung from it. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up the purse, mid-shake, with a coin visible in the neck; the left hand is cupped to his mouth as though whispering. Background: a narrow stone wall walkway with a crenellated parapet, bell towers at intervals each with a small bronze bell on a bracket, the distant red glow of the Night Rain Market's lanterns below, a pigeon on the parapet, a deepening sky of violet and orange. Power: a few pale blue droplets of water qi gather round the coins and glitter as they clink. Light: low orange dusk light from the upper left with a faint violet rim. Expression: a sly, quick look, one eyebrow raised and the eyes sliding sideways, the mouth curled at one corner over the clink of the purse.

people.imagined: Barefoot on the roots at the foot of a bell tree, her face turned a little to one side, eyes open and unfocused, toes spread on the bark as she feels a far bell on the line.
people.subject: The moment: standing barefoot on a great tree root, head tilted to one side, eyes open on nothing, toes spread wide. Face: a quiet, still, pale face with wide dark unfocused eyes; thin straight brows; a small nose; a calm, slightly open mouth. Hair: black, long and loose, with a bronze bead braided into one lock. Body: slim, upright and utterly balanced, the weight carried on the balls of the feet, the knees slightly bent and the spine very straight. Clothing: a neat charcoal-grey silk robe of fine cloth with a crossed collar bordered in bronze bells, narrow sleeves, trousers rolled to the calf, a small dull bronze bell on a cord at the chest. Hands and objects: both hands hang loosely from her sides, the fingers curled as if holding an unseen cord; her bare feet, toes spread wide on a mossy root, are large in the lower frame. Background: the great roots of an enormous tree coiling like grey-green ridges, moss and ferns between them, a thin cord running up the trunk to a bell hung high among the leaves, pale mist drifting between the trunks, a few rays of green light slanting down. Power: faint green motes of wood qi rise from the root through her soles and ripple along the cord like a heard sound. Light: soft green spirit-light from the upper left with a pale rim along the cheek. Expression: a serene, listening stillness, the wide dark eyes unfocused and the lips just parted, as if she heard through the soles of her feet.

people.imagined: Remembered: the founder in 930 on the road south, a bronze lamp wrapped in cloth on his back, a coil of chain on his shoulder, looking up at the sky with a stubborn face.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder at fifty, walking south with a cloth-wrapped bronze lamp on his back and a coil of bronze chain on his shoulder, looking up at a night sky. Face: a strong, stubborn, heavy face; skin tanned dark; deep lines; thick dark brows; dark intent eyes cast up; a hooked nose; a firm wide mouth; a short grey beard. Hair: thick grey-black, tied up in a knot with a bronze ring. Body: broad, sturdy, solid, walking with the shoulders bent forward under the pack and the chain, the head up and the jaw out. Clothing: a founder's long charcoal-grey silk robe, travel-worn but well brushed, with a bronze-grey brocade over-collar embroidered with warning bells, narrow sleeves, a silk casting apron scorched at the hem; a dull bronze bell on a cord at the chest; boots caked with road dust. Hands and objects: the right hand grips the strap of a pack with a blue-glazed bronze lamp wrapped in cloth, its glazed rim showing at the opening; the left holds a heavy bronze chain over the shoulder. Background: a pale night road under a sky heavy with stars, a line of followers, small and dark, carrying tools and moulds behind him, a dark forest edge to the right, the faint orange glow of a distant town, a low crescent moon. Power: a thin blue glow seeps from the lamp's glaze and a few ember-orange motes of fire qi follow the chain. Light: dim blue moonlight from the upper left. Expression: a stubborn, resolute set of the jaw, the eyes fixed on the road south and the mouth shut, a man who has decided and will not look back. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened.

people.imagined: At the furnace shift change, laughing with his whole mouth open, the chipped front tooth plain, handing out bellows shifts to whoever flattered him best.
people.subject: The moment: laughing loudly with his mouth wide open, a chipped front tooth clearly visible, one arm out directing someone. Face: a broad, red, loud face; shiny brow; bright dark eyes; thick black brows; a big nose; a wide laughing mouth with a front tooth cracked in a triangle; stubble. Hair: black, cropped, a small bronze ring in one lock. Body: big and thick-chested with bare arms, the huge chest thrown out and the head back in the laugh, the other fist on his hip. Clothing: an inner disciple's charcoal-grey silk robe with a bronze-embroidered bell collar, the sleeves cut off at the elbow, a scorched silk casting apron black with bronze splatter, a blackened small bronze bell at his chest. Hands and objects: the right thick arm sweeps out in a pointing gesture, directing a task; the left holds crucible tongs. Background: a cavern of red firelight with a furnace mouth glowing white, crucibles on racks, a row of boys at the bellows in dark silhouette, sparks drifting up into the smoke-black rafters, a rank of finished bells waiting to be hung on the floor. Power: a loose wreath of ember-orange fire qi wisps curls from his shoulders and a few green motes of wood qi ride the sparks. Light: orange firelight from the right with a bronze rim. Expression: a loud, boastful, wide-open laugh, the chipped front tooth showing as a dark triangle and the bright eyes bossy.

people.imagined: In the vine wood at dusk, a single red bean rolling against her lip while she thinks, one hand on a coil of hair-thin wire, cold eyes on the road.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a vine wood at dusk, rolling a red bean against her lower lip, holding a coil of hair-thin wire. Face: a lean, hard, closed face; narrow cold dark eyes; thin straight brows; a sharp nose; a thin mouth with a bright red bean pressed to the lip, the red bean visible and bright. Hair: black, in a tight bun held by a long bronze needle. Body: lean, upright and still, the shoulders square and the head tilted a little down, the long fingers winding the wire with care. Clothing: a close, clean charcoal-grey silk robe of fine cloth with a crossed collar embroidered in bronze bells and narrow sleeves, gloves of dark silk with the thumbs rubbed pale; a small bronze bell shining at her chest. Hands and objects: the right hand winds a coil of near-invisible grey wire round the left palm; a long bell line hangs behind her. Background: a thick dim vine wood, huge trees draped in python-thick vines hung with small bronze bells on cords, the forest road a pale strip winding between them, a faint dusk mist, and close at the left edge a taut line of near-invisible wire catching one thin glint of light at neck height. Power: soft green motes of wood qi cling to the wire like dew, with a faint ember glow at her fingertips. Light: soft pale dusk light from the upper left with a gleam on the bean. Expression: a cold, patient, unhurried stare, the narrow eyes level and the thin mouth closed round the red bean, a woman who has waited a long time and can wait longer.

people.imagined: At the bellows by night, rags tied round both burned wrists, singed hair, looking at the line of unfinished bells wanting to cast his own.
people.subject: The moment: working a bellows with both wrists bound in linen, gazing at a row of bells with hunger. Face: a thin, sooty, intense face; bright, hungry dark eyes; faint brows singed short; a long nose; a tight mouth. Hair: black, the ends singed and sticking out, tied with a bit of cord. Body: thin and sinewy, leaning on the long handle with all his weight, the chest heaving and the jaw tight. Clothing: the plain charcoal-grey silk of an outer disciple, sooty, a crossed collar with a worn bronze border of bells, the sleeves rolled, a scorched silk casting apron; a small bronze bell, black with soot, at his chest; both wrists wrapped in strips of white linen over burns, grey and stained with use. Hands and objects: both hands on the bellows handle, the wrists bound; the bare forearms streaked with soot and old burns. Background: a foundry lit by the red-orange mouth of the furnace, a shower of sparks, a rank of unfinished bell moulds in the shadows, a woman in a scorched apron at the crucible shouting orders, a sack of dross half spilled in the corner, a dark rafter laced with cobwebs. Power: a few small ember-orange motes of fire qi cling to the bound wrists like sparks that will not go out. Light: orange firelight from the front, a bright rim on the cheek. Expression: a hungry, impatient stare at the row of bells, the bright eyes wide and the tight mouth working, a boy straining toward something he does not yet have.

people.imagined: On a cart seat in the sun, dozing, one side of his face burnt red by the road, the oxen choosing their own way, a crated bronze bell behind him.
people.subject: The moment: slumped on a cart seat in the sun with the reins loose, half asleep. Face: a mild, long face; the left half of his face visibly sunburnt red and the right half pale, a clear split, the main mark; closed eyes; soft brows; a round nose; a slack mouth. Hair: brown, matted, with a loose bronze bead. Body: long, slumped, the head lolling to the right so the burnt left cheek faces the viewer, the limbs loose and the reins slack in his open hands. Clothing: a neat charcoal-grey silk robe of good cloth with a crossed collar bordered in bronze bells and narrow sleeves; a little bronze bell resting on his chest on its cord; a straw hat has slid off to hang at his back. Hands and objects: loose reins; a large old bell in straw behind him. Background: a broad flat wagon with a sheet of straw under a great old bell wrapped in sacking, two brown oxen plodding with their heads low, a dusty road winding between dry fields, a line of poplars, a harsh white-gold sun in a pale sky. Power: a few tiny blue droplets of water qi hang in the sunlit air around him like dew that the heat has not yet taken. Light: strong sun from the left, a pale gold haze on the silk. Expression: a sleepy, honest, open face, the eyes half closed in the sun and the mouth slack, nothing hidden in it.

people.imagined: Beside the furnace, holding a bell steady in both hands for the disciple's seal, seven holes pierced in her ears and only one holds a stud.
people.subject: The moment: holding a bronze bell steadily in both hands, calm eyes on it. Face: a plain, patient, brown face; steady dark eyes; level brows; a small nose; a calm mouth; each ear pierced seven times, six holes empty and one with a tiny bronze stud, plainly visible. Hair: black, tied back with a bronze ring. Body: sturdy and still, standing straight and square with the elbows tucked and the head slightly tilted as if listening to the bell's hum. Clothing: a clean charcoal-grey silk robe of fine cloth with a crossed collar embroidered in bronze bells and narrow sleeves; a small bronze bell on a cord at the chest; a dark silk glove on the left hand. Hands and objects: both wide hands steady a medium bronze bell by its crown. Background: a casting yard with a heap of broken bronze shards swept into a neat pile, a row of clay moulds drying in the sun, a pole hung with bells in various sizes, a brick furnace with a thin ribbon of smoke, and a tall pale-faced young woman with nine cracked bells in the blur beside her. Power: faint green motes of wood qi gather round the bell's rim and tremble with its hum. Light: orange furnace light from the right, a bronze gleam on the bell. Expression: a patient, loyal, listening calm, the steady dark eyes on the bell and the mouth quiet, the whole face leaning toward a sound.

people.imagined: In the bathhouse steam, mid-laugh, head thrown back so the whole house can find her by the sound, steam around her face.
people.subject: The moment: laughing with her head thrown back in a steamy bathhouse corridor. Face: a round, rosy, damp face; closed laughing eyes; dimpled cheeks; a wide open laughing mouth; a glow of steam on the throat and chin. Hair: brown, in damp curls plastered to the forehead. Body: round, strong and light, the arms wrapped over her middle and the head thrown back so that the throat shines with steam, the shoulders shaking. Clothing: a plain charcoal-grey silk robe of good cloth, damp at the collar, with a thin bronze bell border and the sleeves rolled to the elbow; wet trousers at the knee; a small bronze bell with a green patina at her chest. Hands and objects: both hands pressed to her stomach, laughing; a wooden bucket sits at her feet. Background: a narrow bathhouse corridor of wooden walls beaded with water, white steam rolling along the floor, a row of paper lanterns glowing orange through the mist, a partly open door with the shapes of bathers inside, a stack of folded towels on a bench. Power: soft green motes of wood qi and faint warm ember motes of fire qi float up in the steam like drifting petals. Light: soft warm golden light from the upper left, diffused in the steam. Expression: a loud, merry, helpless laugh with the eyes screwed shut and the cheeks dimpled, a girl who cannot stop.

people.imagined: At the foot of a ladder tree, bending to tie his bootlace for the third time, a rice ball tucked in the fork above him by an unseen friend.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at the foot of a ladder tree, retying a bootlace with a frown of concentration. Face: a broad, earnest face; tongue between his teeth; frowning brows; a square jaw. Hair: dark and short, a small bronze pin in a tiny knot. Body: stocky and steady, crouched on the balls of his feet with the knees apart and the shoulders curved. Clothing: a plain charcoal-grey silk robe of good cloth with narrow sleeves pushed up and a thin bronze bell border at the collar; a silk-wrapped climbing harness with brass rings crossing the chest; a coil of rope at his hip; a small bright bronze bell at his chest. Hands and objects: both thick hands pull a bootlace into a careful double knot, fumbling and looping it twice; a rope ladder hangs behind him. Background: a forest like a cathedral of enormous trunks with a rope ladder dropping from a high branch, a small rice ball wrapped in a leaf resting in the fork at the ladder's foot, thin shafts of green light, a mossy ground, and in the blur a tall night guide's cloak at the edge of a path. Power: a faint green shimmer of wood qi gathers around the rope ladder. Light: dappled green spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: a patient, slow, steady frown of concentration, the tongue between the teeth and the earnest brows drawn together.
